narrative.headline: TabNet is driven mainly by nr.employed, month and euribor3m.
narrative.body: The five macro-economic indicators together account for 50% of the model's attribution — it is largely reading the state of the economy at the time of the call. nr.employed, month and euribor3m are the top three. day_of_week ranks 8 of 20 (3.0% of attribution), consistent with its nearly flat subscription rate in the EDA. TabNet's own masks and SHAP agree with Spearman ρ = 0.38 across the 20 features; 3 of their top-5 features coincide (euribor3m, month, nr.employed).
narrative.caveat: SHAP shows what the model uses, not what causes subscription. A feature can have high SHAP importance and no causal relationship with the outcome.
